en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a large neoclassical government building identified as the Konak (Palais de Justice) in Salonique (Thessaloniki). A dense crowd fills the square in front, with soldiers in formation, horse‑drawn carriages, and people gathered for a festivity. A minaret is visible on the left. Multilingual captions describe the scene as a holiday celebration related to the Constitution.
